Product Manager, Energy
Gridly
Dublin, Ireland (hybrid)

About the role
You will own the roadmap for our connected product line and work with engineering, design and partners to ship features customers value. You will talk to customers every week, decide priorities with data, and report results to leadership.

Responsibilities
- Define the product strategy and roadmap
- Work with firmware, cloud and app teams on delivery
- Run customer discovery and turn it into requirements
- Measure the impact of every release and report on it

Requirements
- 3+ years of product management for connected hardware

clean.letter:
Dear Gridly team,

I grew up in a house where the heating was always wrong, which is why I moved from firmware into product. Energy products are where I want to work, because people should be able to understand and trust them.

At Northlight Devices I managed the roadmap for the smart thermostat line together with firmware and app teams, and I coordinated user research sessions and turned the findings into backlog items. I also worked with three ecosystem partners on certification and launch plans. Before that, I built over-the-air update tooling as a firmware engineer, so I know what delivery looks like from the engineering side.

I would welcome a conversation about the roadmap for Gridly's connected product line. I am based in Cork and no sponsorship is needed for a role in Ireland.

Alex Rivera
